page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6.26xlarge is a compute-optimized server instance deployed on the KVM hypervisor platform. It features 104 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8269CY processors operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The host is configured with 192.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 1.85 GB of RAM per dedicated vCPU core. This resource ratio prioritizes raw CPU processing density over memory capacity. The instance includes no local storage or attached discrete GPU acceleration hardware.

Network performance is driven by a 25 Gbps baseline bandwidth allocation, with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high vCPU density combined with lower per-core memory allocation reduces hardware overhead for heavily parallelized, CPU-bound workloads. Key hardware trade-offs include complete dependence on remote network-attached volumes for disk access and an absence of specialized GPU compute units. The ecs.c6.26xlarge instance profile is structured for high-performance computing, batch video processing, software compilation pipelines, and CPU-focused analytics applications.
